title: Claim Frequency by Peril Type
dataSources: Lemonade policies (`lemonade:policy`), home claims (`claim:home`), premium bills (`homeinsurance:premium`), and renewal offers (`homeinsurance:renewal`).
app: Lemonade policy exports, home claim filings, premium billing snapshots, renewal offer logs, and coverage review notes streamed into Splunk HEC under `index=personal`.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=claim:home claim_type=*
| bin _time span=1y
| stats count as claims, sum(payout_usd) as total_payout by _time claim_type
| chart sum(claims) over _time by claim_type
description: Trends annual home claim counts and payout totals grouped by peril or claim type.
value: Peril-frequency patterns reveal whether deductibles or riders should shift before the next renewal cycle.
implementation: Ensure each claim export includes `claim_type` and `payout_usd`, then review the yearly mix before renewal.
visualization: Stacked column chart of claims by year and peril type.
grandmaExplanation: It spots which kinds of home damage you claim for most often over the years.
